catches: Bill credits only — applied to the Boost Mobile account, not cash and not transferable

Credits are applied over two months; first credit appears within two payment cycles of validation
You must already be a Boost customer for at least 30 days before you can refer
Friend must activate as a new Boost account, not as an added line on an existing account; plans under $25/month are excluded
Up to 5 friends per calendar year
